summary: Peace Acquisition Corp. filed a Form 8-K announcing that holders of its units from its initial public offering may begin separately trading the underlying ordinary shares, rights, and warrants on or about June 4, 2026. The ordinary shares, rights, and warrants will trade on Nasdaq under symbols PECE, PECER, and PECEW, respectively; units not separated will continue under PECEU. No fractional rights will be issued. This is a routine post-IPO operational step, not a special situation event.
